cells.quote: The association between EBT enactment and learning, using residualized BASIC performance, was positive and statistically significant (r = 0.315, p < .05) as well. A similar pattern appeared for residualized course grades (r = 0.316, p < .05).
cells.note: The study reports a class-level measured association, not a randomized treatment comparison.
